description:
Extract the dropdown rendering logic from the monolithic `input.ex` into a dedicated `Input.Dropdown` module.

**What to Extract:**
The dropdown functionality currently lives in `input.ex`:
- Fields: `autocomplete_provider`, `autocomplete_suggestions`, `autocomplete_selected`, `autocomplete_active`, `scroll_offset`
- `render_dropdown/2` function (~lines 530-620) — renders suggestions as text lines
- `dropdown_primary_col_width/1` helper
- `render_dropdown_item/5`, `render_dropdown_two_col/8`, `render_dropdown_with_desc/7`, `render_dropdown_label_only/6` helpers
- `refresh_autocomplete/1`, `autocomplete_navigate/3`, `autocomplete_accept/1`, `autocomplete_accept_and_submit/1`, `dismiss_autocomplete/1` functions

**New Module Location:**
`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/input/dropdown.ex`

**New Module Shape:**
```elixir
defmodule OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input.Dropdown do
  alias OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete.Suggestion
  alias OctoPi.TUI.Theme
  alias OctoPi.TUI.WrapAnsi
  
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
    suggestions: [Suggestion.t()],
    selected: non_neg_integer(),
    active: boolean(),
    scroll_offset: non_neg_integer(),
    theme: Theme.t() | nil,
    width: pos_integer()
  }
  
  defstruct suggestions: [],
            selected: 0,
            active: false,
            scroll_offset: 0,
            theme: nil,
            width: 80
  
  @doc "Render dropdown lines. Returns [] when inactive."
  @spec render(t()) :: [String.t()]
  def render(%__MODULE__{active: false}), do: []
  def render(%__MODULE__{} = dropdown), do: ...
  
  @doc "Navigate selection up/down."
  @spec navigate(t(), -1 | 1) :: t()
  def navigate(%__MODULE__{} = dropdown, delta), do: ...
  
  @doc "Accept the currently selected suggestion."
  @spec accept(t()) :: {t(), Suggestion.t() | nil}
  def accept(%__MODULE__{} = dropdown), do: ...
  
  @doc "Accept and submit (Enter key behavior)."
  @spec accept_and_submit(t(), String.t()) :: {t(), String.t() | nil}
  def accept_and_submit(%__MODULE__{} = dropdown, input_value), do: ...
  
  @doc "Dismiss the dropdown."
  @spec dismiss(t()) :: t()
  def dismiss(%__MODULE__{} = dropdown), do: %{dropdown | active: false, suggestions: [], selected: 0}
  
  @doc "Update suggestions from provider based on current input value."
  @spec refresh(t(), String.t(), provider) :: t()
  def refresh(%__MODULE__{provider: nil} = dropdown, _value, _provider), do: dropdown
  def refresh(%__MODULE__{provider: provider} = dropdown, value, _provider) do
    # Move provider to this module's state
  end
end
```

**Preserve Exact Behavior:**
- Copy ALL dropdown-related functions verbatim from `input.ex`
- The `Suggestion` struct comes from `OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete`
- Keep all the same ANSI escape sequences and styling
- Preserve scroll viewport logic (center selection, show (X/Y) indicator)
- Keep two-column layout when width permits

**Type Definitions:**
Move to the new module:
- `@dropdown_max_visible 5`
- `@primary_column_gap 2`
- `@min_description_width 10`
- `@min_primary_col_width 12`
- `@max_primary_col_width 32`

**Keep in input.ex (but reference dropdown):**
- The fields remain in Input struct
- Initialize dropdown with provider on Input creation

**Tests:**
Update `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs`:
- Move dropdown-specific tests to a new `Input.DropdownTest` module
- OR keep tests in `InputTest` and call `Input.Dropdown.render/2` directly

**Exit Criteria:**
- `Input.Dropdown` module compiles and passes existing dropdown tests
- `Input` still compiles (with stubs that delegate to Dropdown)
- No behavioral change to dropdown rendering
title: Extract Input.Dropdown sub-module
